items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: And, uh, sitting with Sharky, Sharky let me, you know, take down and let me do most of the driving.

ctx.x: I saw him a few months ago. He was at Tulane. I didn't know what the hell he was. He's a fine boy. He is. Uh, when you started out on trumpet, did you sit in any before you ever began to come professional?

Oh yeah. I sat in with quite a few bands. Dick, I sat in with Pinky. When Pinky was with the Owls. I used to go around. Well in those days you could sit, nobody was Union, sit in with anybody, you know? I used to always, wherever Sharky played I'd be, when I was a youngster. And, uh, sitting with Sharky, Sharky let me, you know, take down and let me do most of the driving. He used to get a kick out of me because I was about, oh I was only about sixteen years old, just a youngster.
Did you model your playing on anybody in those days in particular?
